_comment: Performance metrics for Captain's Cottage. There is NO Airbnb host API — booking-derived metrics come from Airbnb booking/reservation emails via the Gmail MCP (blog-metrics agent); dashboard-only metrics (search impressions, listing conversion) are manual pastes. Conversion rate is intentionally tracked-but-not-chased here: it is listing-side, not the blog's job. The blog optimizes for occupancy and booked-nights.

assumptions.note: True occupancy needs an availability denominator Airbnb does not expose by email. Until set per-month, occupancyEst = bookedNights / availableNightsPerMonthDefault and is APPROXIMATE. Override availableNights per period when known.

current.source: manual paste from Airbnb Performance dashboard
current.conversionNote: Dashboard-only, manual. Tracked for context, NOT a blog success metric (improving it = editing the Airbnb listing).

wins.note: Baseline recorded. bookingLeadDays 38.5, Airbnb conversion 0.32%. Blog pipeline live (Workstream A+B). Future entries: dated, factual, correlational — never claim blog caused a booking.
